svg.text: SR-donor atrial patches transplanted into AFIB recipients: within-record logit change (modified - original), record-level 95% CI

Filled = real intervention; hollow = matched sham (flatten + spectrum-matched random patch at the same position, or total-modification surrogate). 77 eligible AFIB recipients; donors averaged within record first.
aligned patch (3 donors) vs total-mod. sham
aligned patch (3 donors) vs total-mod. sham
C. other logits: aligned patch minus matched sham (left) and minus flatten (right)
